description: Creates a list in the workspace, optionally pre-filled with up to 250 property or person IDs. Filed records become prospects unless `add_as_prospects` is false. Free; no credits are charged.

add_as_prospects.description: Whether the records also become prospects in the workspace. Defaults to true. Pass false only when the user does not want these records tracked as prospects.

record_ids.description: Internal property or person IDs to file right away (max 250). Omit to create an empty list.

source_type.description: What the list holds. Defaults to properties.

name: dealmachine_list_create
